body:
This is my first time making a PR review.
I don't have enough experience with the Godot engine's source code, but I hope that this 1-line PR is a good start.


What I have done:
1. Compiled the branch https://github.com/Infiland/godot/tree/issue-118308 as is
2. Ran the example code in the editor - confirmed that it works ✅
```
var array = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]
	
	var i = 0
	while array[i] < 9:
		i += 1
```
3. Ran `./bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64 --test` - confirmed that it passes ✅
4. Ran a performance check in the editor using the code
```
	for count in 10:
		var i := 0
		var time_start := Time.get_ticks_usec()
		while i < 100_000_000:
			i += 1
		var elapsed := Time.get_ticks_usec() - time_start
		print("done in\t%s" % elapsed) 
```
4. Generated an export template for a release build
5. Exported and ran the project with the same performance check as in step 3

Because I noticed significant time increase of 7.85% compared to Godot 4.7.stable, I had to check if this is due to this PR or due to other changes in Godot master. That is why, I additionally made a "control" build where the change in gdscript_compiler.cpp is commented out. So additionally:

6. Ran the example code in step 2 in the control build as a sanity check
7. Ran `./bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64 --test` - confirmed that it fails - the test is correct. ✅
8. Ran the code in step 4 to compare the impact of this PR against the control build
9. repeated steps 4 and 5 with the control build.

The additional line count has added 7.21% to the execution time when running in DEBUG mode from the editor. This translates to 96 msec for 10_000_000 loops - acceptable for me.
Most importantly, there is no impact on performance in release builds.

The bare minimum project I ran my tests against:
[example-4.7.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29501471/example-4.7.zip)

As my first PR review, please feel free to nitpick and suggest improvements.
(This is an organic, hand-crafted review. I manually searched for the emoji icons too)
